the effects of the prolific Finnish Landrace breed on the reproductive performance of crossbred ewes.

the Romanov ewe is superior to the Finnish Landrace in prolificacy and lambing age, whereas the Finnish Landrace ram is superior to the Romanov in lamb growth and carcass quality.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Romanov ewes are more prolific than Finnish Landrace ewes when mated to Targhee rams.
